metadata.article_title: Penalty for furnishing incorrect information in reports or certificates.

article.title: Penalty for furnishing incorrect information in reports or certificates.
article.content:
463Penalty for furnishing incorrect information in reports or certificates.

Section 463  ·  Chapter XXI  ·  page 549 of the Act
(1) Any accountant or merchant banker or registered valuer, shall be liable to pay a penalty of Rs. 10000 for any incorrect information in any report or certificate furnished under any provision of this Act or the rules made thereunder.
(2) The penalty under sub-section (1) shall be payable for each such report or certificate.
(3) The penalty under sub-section (1) shall be payable on directions of the Assessing Officer or the Joint Commissioner (Appeals) or the Commissioner (Appeals) where the incorrect information mentioned in sub-section (1) is found by such authority in the course of any proceedings under this Act.
(4) In this section,—
(a) "merchant banker" means Category I merchant banker registered with the Securities and Exchange Board of India established under section 3 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India Act, 1992 (15 of 1992); and
(b) "registered valuer" means a person registered as a valuer under section 514.
